controlled_reproductions.name: current same-name user and project scopes
controlled_reproductions.result: Claude 2.1.252 warned about multiple scopes but started one child
controlled_reproductions.interpretation: the warning is a diagnostic signal, not proof of duplicate loading on the current release

controlled_reproductions.name: two distinct MCP registrations targeting the same server.ts with different peer environment
controlled_reproductions.result: one Claude parent started two children and the broker exposed two logical peer IDs
controlled_reproductions.interpretation: duplicate runtimes remain reproducible when the loader is given distinct registrations

controlled_reproductions.name: two distinct MCP registrations targeting the same server.ts with the same stable peer environment
controlled_reproductions.result: two children remained alive while the broker exposed only the later PID under one stable ID
controlled_reproductions.interpretation: the runtimes competed for one mailbox and either runtime could consume or unregister it

delivery_probes.caveat: legacy broker delivered=1 means a poll consumed the row before channel injection; it is not proof that Claude received or acted on the message

root_cause.loader_boundary: the repository does not spawn a second server.ts process; Claude registration composition or older scope-resolution behavior does
root_cause.protocol_boundary: stable peer identity was also used as runtime ownership, polling authority, and unregister authority
root_cause.loss_window: legacy polling marked rows delivered before the selected runtime attempted channel notification

verification_baseline.bun_build: server.ts, broker.ts, and codex-server.ts built successfully for Bun
verification_baseline.typescript: 17 pre-existing errors across broker, tests, codex-direct, dashboard, and server
verification_baseline.dependency_audit: 8 high advisories across four transitive packages

implemented_fix.protocol: payload v2 stable peer identity plus private process owner lease, fenced standby, visibility claims, and explicit application acknowledgment
implemented_fix.compatibility: legacy unleased peers retain register, heartbeat, poll, and unregister behavior; an expired v2 lease permits legacy rollback
implemented_fix.privacy: peer listings omit process instance and lease secrets; diagnostics omit message text
implemented_fix.client_receipt: channel metadata and manual output expose message IDs; only the ack_message tool finalizes receipt
